svg.title: Control Studio's decoupled group against paired PI
svg.desc: When vessel 1's setpoint steps 2 degrees alone, Control Studio's decoupler lowers heater 2 by 6.19 points in the same update, and the unchanged vessel 2 moves at most 0.194 degrees, inside its 0.2 degree band; with Lesson 71's paired PI it rose 0.269 degrees. Under a 10 kilowatt load on vessel 1, the decoupler moves vessel 2 by 0.128 degrees against 0.049 degrees with paired PI.
svg.text: Control Studio's decoupled group against paired PI
